selection: Exactly the four REL_16_6 regress files listed. No sampling at eval time.
coverage: Uppercase-keyword SELECT subset (FROM/WHERE, arithmetic, AND/OR, calls). Real postgres regress scripts use lowercase keywords, COPY, CREATE, and much else: those files are in the denominator; misses are retained. Not DDL/joins/subqueries as claimed coverage.
exclusions: COPY, CREATE, INSERT, plpgsql, and all other regress directories not listed

reference.name: PostgreSQL raw parser (libpg_query / pg_query)
reference.work: parse analysis only, not query execution
